defs.def: having a lot to do; perhaps not free to do sth else because you are working on sth 忙碌的；无暇的

ex.s: I know she's been busy recently, and I understand that.
ex.t: 我知道她最近很忙，我也理解。

ex.s: David 1 as busy as a(n) __________ 2 kill two __________ with one stone 3 When the cat’s away, the __________ will play.
ex.t: 大卫　1 像____一样忙（as busy as a bee 像蜜蜂一样忙）　2 一石二____（kill two birds with one stone 一石二鸟）　3 猫儿不在，____作怪（When the cat's away, the mice will play 猫走鼠称王）。

ex.s: With such busy lives, it can be hard to try and find the time to work out.
ex.t: 生活如此忙碌，很难找到时间去锻炼。

ex.s: People often feel they are too busy to volunteer.
ex.t: 人们常觉得自己太忙而无法做志愿者。

ex.s: Young people are too busy to interact with nature.
ex.t: 年轻人太忙了，无暇与自然互动。

ex.s: Still, continuing to challenge yourself mentally and keeping your mind busy can only help.
ex.t: 尽管如此，继续在智力上挑战自己、让大脑忙碌起来只会对你有益。

defs.def: spending a lot of time on sth 忙于（做某事）

ex.s: Her mother was busy working.
ex.t: 她的母亲忙于工作。

ex.s: For example, to describe someone who is always working or busy doing something, we can say they are 2 __________.
ex.t: 例如，要描述一个总是在工作或忙于某事的人，我们可以说他们是 2 __________。

ex.s: Later, on the phone she apologised and explained that she was busy with work because someone was 2____, I wish she had come!
ex.t: 后来，她在电话中道歉，并解释说她忙于工作，因为有人2 ____ ，我希望她来！

ex.s: Nielsen always felt he should be doing comedy but his good looks and distinguished voice kept him busy in dramatic roles.
ex.t: 尼尔森一直觉得自己应该演喜剧，但他英俊的外表和出众的声音让他忙于戏剧角色。

ex.s: My husband and I had just sold our house and we were busy ___41___ the beloved home our family had spent 23 years filling up.
ex.t: 我和丈夫刚卖掉房子，正忙着___41___我们家花了23年填满的这个心爱之家。
